description: Use this when the user asks how many chapters a Bible book has or where each chapter ends, or you need valid chapter and verse numbers before reading. Takes a book name and lists each chapter with its last verse number in the World English Bible (the WEB omits a few verses, so this can exceed the number of verses printed). It does not return Bible text.

book.description: Book name, abbreviation or code, e.g. "Romans", "1 Cor" or "PSA".

name: list_bible_chapters

lastVerse.description: Number of the last verse in the chapter.

title: List chapters of a book
